verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://mirrors.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary. Other items drawn from that file show it carries real content, including product positioning and how Mirrors fits with Langfuse, LangSmith and Braintrust, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs also describe a workflow where a coding agent writes corrections. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the docs (/docs.md returns 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or deeper agent-oriented reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the file.
